key.notes: Global key only. Do not reinterpret this as a local key region.

chord.notes: Production chord evidence must come from the trusted lv-chordia path; monophonic/no-chord spans may be withheld.

roman_numeral.notes: Oracle score is not end-to-end accuracy. Withhold when either trusted chord or trusted key evidence is absent.

harmonic_function.notes: Derived from Roman-numeral/key context; not an independent perception result.

cadence.reason: Low held-out quality; prior adjacent-pattern detector over-matches and is not product-safe.

key_region.reason: Current implementation is a placeholder/global-key region, not validated local-key or modulation detection.

rhythm.notes: Temporal density/rest features are deterministic measurements; richer musical interpretation remains incremental.

melody.notes: Default experimental symbolic Melody interpretation. Upstream provides the full MIDI-to-melody CP inference path; exact checkpoint identity/checksum must be pinned before production image admission. Classical and general performance MIDI remain unvalidated.

melody_register_peak.notes: Highest melody note with temporal span. Deterministic from admitted Melody note evidence.

melody_register_low.notes: Lowest melody note with temporal span. Deterministic from admitted Melody note evidence.

melody_interval_summary.notes: Stepwise/leap/repeated-note ratio summary. Deterministic from admitted Melody note evidence.

melody_large_leap.reason: Threshold-based heuristic (≥8 semitones) without musical validation. Needs corpus evidence.

melody_characteristic_interval.notes: Most common interval. Pending jSymbolic consolidation.

melody_contour_ascending.notes: Ascending contour span with ≥6 notes and >75% directional ratio. Conservative temporal finding.

melody_contour_descending.notes: Descending contour span with ≥6 notes and >75% directional ratio. Conservative temporal finding.

melody_contour_arch.reason: Heuristic contour classifier with arbitrary thresholds. Needs validated contour representation.

melody_motif.reason: Custom interval-window matcher without benchmark validation. Needs motif-annotated dataset evaluation.

melody_activity_dense.notes: Dense melodic passage detected via sliding-window note density. Deterministic measurement.

melody_activity_sparse.notes: Sparse melodic passage detected via sliding-window note density. Deterministic measurement.

evaluation.details: Legacy skyline heuristic baseline. Retained for evaluation comparison only.

skyline_baseline.notes: DEPRECATED: Do not use for production. Skyline heuristic has 100% contamination rate on classical piano and F1=0.343 on pop/arranged music. MidiBERT is the experimental product Melody route.

time_signature.notes: Meter/time-signature detection from MIDI via music21.

audio_tempo.notes: Audio-derived tempo estimate from the beat engine.

section.reason: Historical section evidence only; new production generation was retired by #1132.

audio_structure.reason: Historical structure-summary evidence only; new production generation was retired by #1132.

rhythm_density.notes: Note density profile over time; deterministic windowed measurement.

harmonic_rhythm.reason: Depends on unreliable chord stream for change-point detection.

voice_leading.reason: Depends on unreliable chord stream for voice tracking.

evaluation.dataset: synthetic fixtures + repository piano + Candombe CC BY 4.0 probe
evaluation.details: #455/#468: mono 22.05 kHz canonicalization stabilizes onset strength, spectral centroid, and relative band-energy evidence for bounded within-work comparison.

perceptual_series.validated_domain: within-work measured comparison under identical mono 22.05 kHz preprocessing
perceptual_series.notes: Measured evidence only. RMS is an amplitude proxy, not calibrated loudness. Do not infer semantic timbre adjectives, source identity, section labels, cross-song rankings, or population norms.

measured_change.validated_domain: within-work candidate navigation over exact promoted perceptual_series evidence
measured_change.notes: A candidate means only that multiple declared measured feature groups changed around this time under robust_top_peaks_v1. Ranking is within-Work proposal ordering, not confidence, significance, importance, a section boundary, a chorus/drop/climax, transition importance, or emotion.

evaluation.dataset: synthetic A-B-A control + real-stack repository audio path
evaluation.details: #1175 / PR #1190: method-specific candidate spans are exposed as synchronized Map navigation with exact source Version provenance; corpus quality/canonization remains intentionally unclaimed.

structure_map.notes: Map/navigation surface only. Letter labels are descriptor-similarity hints, not verse/chorus/motif/canonical form. Inspector/annotation/Ask exposure remains false until separately earned.

supplied_text_alignment.validated_domain: user-supplied, licensed, public-domain, or otherwise permitted reference text aligned to one exact audio Version
supplied_text_alignment.notes: Backend-only #1181 slice. Supplied text remains authoritative; Whisper provides timing evidence only. Direct matches are method-qualified, weak direct matches remain ambiguous, unmatched words remain failed, and no line interpolation/extrapolation, lyrics acquisition, beat/pulse authority, or frontend lane is introduced.
